params.cooldownDurationSeconds: The cooldown duration applied to new unstake requests.

canStartUnstake(bytes32,uint256).notice: Returns true when the requested unstake is valid under the current policy.

claimableAmount(bytes32).notice: Returns the currently claimable unstake amount for a person identifier.

cooldownDuration().notice: Returns the configured unstake cooldown duration.

isPoliticalRightsBlocked(bytes32).notice: Returns true when political rights are blocked by an active unstaking cooldown.

previewCooldownEnd(uint64).notice: Returns the cooldown end timestamp for a requested start timestamp.

stakeRegistry().notice: Returns the configured stake registry address.

@param stakeRegistryAddress The stake registry address.
